svg.title: coderprint: 704k lines of code in use, of 1.6M written, all time
svg.desc: 703,689 lines of code in use (470,943 in production, 232,746 in tests), of 1,591,953 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 4,348 commits across all branches, 72 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 17 days, and 6 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.5M lines of code. The bars end on 03NOV2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 60%, Lean 17%, Python 13%, TypeScript 5%, JavaScript 3%, Shell 2%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 44% is kept.
